evidenceKind: ODA section review plus generated local reader-matrix control
question: Does a structurally ambiguous AcDs DataIndex publish a partial typed/raw section or permit attachment retry contamination?

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.summary: The segment index maps segment indexes to stream ranges; the DataIndex maps object entries to a segment index/local offset/schema index; the data segment stores records keyed by those indexed local offsets and carries the object handle in each record header.
authority.limit: The ODA layout does not define recovery semantics for duplicate or conflicting index entries; local fail-closed behavior is a safety policy, not a new normative DWG rule.

localAudit.capture: dwgReader18::captureRawDwgDataSections parses into local staged raw/typed vectors and returns false for parseFailed, structurally invalid, or !replayAllowed DataStorage before publishing either vector.
localAudit.caller: dwgReader18::readDwgTables returns false when captureRawDwgDataSections fails; object traversal is downstream of that stage.
localAudit.linker: linkDataStorage only sees sections successfully committed by the capture path; no production guard was added because the suspected invalid-section attachment was not reachable through the audited caller.

generatedControl.input: The existing from-scratch AC1027 multi-record AcDs fixture is mutated so two DataIndex rows target the same physical record location, yielding a structural diagnostic and replayAllowed=false.
assertions: no raw DataStorage section or typed record index is published
the same reader captures the unmodified valid section after refusal
the existing positive reordered-payload/LINE-sentinel control remains intact
generatedControl.fixtures: All bytes are generated in test code; no DWG, DXF, or SAB file is added.

disposition.classification: EXISTING_FAIL_CLOSED_CAPTURE_CONFIRMED; generated atomic-publication and same-reader-retry regression added
disposition.worktree: Uncommitted in the pre-existing broadly dirty worktree; no unrelated changes were staged.
